requirements.text: 3+ years in product engineering with a focus on LLM-based systems
Agentic or LLM systems you've taken to production, covering tool calling, orchestration and context management
Experience conceptualising, architecting and building a product end to end
Python and TypeScript across backend and product surfaces
Experience with LLM evaluations, regression testing or AI observability tooling
Healthcare or another highly regulated domain
Able to explain technical tradeoffs clearly to clinicians and other non-technical people
Python, TypeScript, LLMs, agentic AI frameworks, RAG and retrieval systems, APIs, backend services. Modern React-based frameworks are a plus.
